text.body: ||śrī caṇḍīpāṭha || ||oṃ śrī devaiḥ namaḥ || ||atha caṃḍīpāṭhaḥ || yā devī sarvabhūteṣu viṣṇumāyeti śabditā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-16|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu cetanetyabhidhīyate | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-19|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu buddhirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-22|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu nidrārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-25|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu kṣudhārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-28|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu cchāyārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-31|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu śaktirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-34|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu tṛṣṇārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-37|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu kṣāntirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-40|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu jātirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-43|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu lajjārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-46|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu śāntirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-49|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu śraddhārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-52|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu kāntirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-55|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmīrūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-58|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu vṛttirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-61|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu smṛtirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-64|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu dayārūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-67|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu tuṣṭirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-70|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu mātṛrūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-73|| yā devī sarvabhūteṣu bhrāntirūpeṇa saṃsthitā | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-76|| indriyāṇāmadhiṣṭhātrī bhutānāñcākhileṣu yā | bhūteṣu satataṃ tasyai vyāptidevyai namo namaḥ ||5-77|| citirūpeṇa yā kṛtsnametad vyāpya sthitā jagat | namastasyai namastasyai namastasyai namo namaḥ ||5-80|| || iti caṃḍīpāṭhaḥ ||
